decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker: 'Add and delete bookmark flows'; round 1 client: 'I can see it saving links ... That part feels good.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Basic save-by-URL presented and observed working, conforms to reference.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker: 'Add and delete bookmark flows'; round 1 client: '... and deleting. That part feels good.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Delete presented and observed working, conforms.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker: 'list/grid views'; round 1 client: 'it looks really nice ... That part feels good.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Readability-first list display presented; grid is an equivalent/extra UI choice. Conforms at the presented level.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker: 'Search, sorting, list/grid views'; round 1 client: '... searching ... That part feels good.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Search presented and observed working; no evidence of divergence from basic full-text search.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker: 'Search, sorting, ...'; round 1 client: '... sorting them ... That part feels good.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Sort presented and observed working, conforms.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker presented an add flow with no metadata discovery (manual title, generic 'Saved to your personal library', 'New' tag). Round 1 client: 'Saving doesn't pull in the link's info ... I expect it to figure out the page's title and a short description on its own ... a stand-in/simulated version is fine.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Divergence established independently: the presented save flow requires manual entry, contradicting REF-BM-02 auto-collection. Client supplies the reference-conforming behaviour in place of the mismatch → correct.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker presented only 'Add and delete bookmark flows'. Round 1 client: 'I can't edit a bookmark after saving. The only choice on a saved item is Delete. I need to be able to go back and fix a title, change its description, move it to a different collection, or adjust its tags.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Divergence established independently: edit (REF-BM-04) absent from presented scope (only add/delete). Client requests the missing related reference requirement → extend.

decisions.evidence: Round 2 maker: 'Pasting a URL now simulates metadata discovery and fills the title, description, and suggested tags automatically.' Round 2 client (bare approval): 'When I paste a link it now fills in the title, a description, and some tags on its own, and I can still tweak them ... I'm happy with it.'
decisions.note: Implementation review. Revised presentation now conforms to REF-BM-02/03 (auto-fill and editable); recorded as a new conforming decision. Client response is bare approval, so no capture is scored here (favicon/preview aspects of REF-BM-02 not established from the record).

decisions.evidence: Round 2 maker: 'Every bookmark now has an Edit action for changing its URL, title, description, collection, and tags.' Round 2 client: 'every bookmark now has an Edit option ... with my changes sticking after a reload ... I'm happy with it.'
decisions.note: Implementation review. Revised presentation now conforms to REF-BM-04; recorded as a new conforming decision. Client gives bare approval only.
